Browse a species to check its expanded tree. Equipped moves and your expedition’s actual evolution history appear inside the game’s paused Abyssals menu.

Battle conditions

  • Burn halves Attack for physical moves and drains 1/8 maximum HP each turn.
  • Poison drains 1/8 maximum HP. Bad poison starts at 1/16 and grows each turn; switching resets its escalation.
  • Paralysis halves Speed and can stop an action. Sleep, freeze and confusion affect actions separately.
  • Priority is checked before Speed. Faster partners act first within the same priority.
  • Weather, terrain, screens, one-hit wards, contact guards, move seals, marks and recurring fields are active. See each move’s effect for its duration.
  • HP bars stay steady until impact, then drain with a slowing finish. Wilderness damage remains lethal; practice stops at 1 HP.
